summary_1line: After the Rajasuya, guests depart; Krishna leaves for Dwaraka; Vyasa warns Yudhishthira that ominous portents will lead to a future destruction of Kshatriyas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna ascends his Garuda-bannered chariot while Yudhishthira and his brothers walk beside it to bid him farewell.
The sage Vyasa sits on a golden carpet before Yudhishthira and prophesies the coming destruction of the Kshatriyas.
In a prophetic vision, the white, towering Shiva seated on a bull faces the southern direction, holding a trident and wearing tiger skin.
